_comment: Shipped demo app credentials — registered ONCE by the demo publisher, committed so end users provide nothing (they just click Connect and consent). Google: OAuth client of type 'Desktop app' — Google documents desktop client secrets as non-confidential, so committing is standard practice (gcloud/rclone do the same). Feishu: custom app with user-auth calendar readonly scope and redirect URI http://localhost:5174/oauth/feishu. Local .env overrides these values.
